# Pixel Pomodoro Timer

A pixel-themed Pomodoro timer that runs entirely offline in your browser. It features 25-minute work sessions and 5-minute breaks, with start/pause and reset controls.

## Features

- 25-minute work mode and 5-minute break mode
- Large countdown display
- Start/Pause and Reset buttons
- Keyboard accessible with labeled controls
- Responsive design down to 360px width
- Pixel-art aesthetic using only CSS
- No external dependencies, network requests, or assets

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Use the Start button to begin the timer, Pause to stop it, and Reset to return to the initial 25-minute work session.

## Files

- `index.html` – main HTML structure
- `style.css` – pixel-themed styling
- `script.js` – timer logic

## Accessibility

- Buttons have `aria-label` attributes that update with state
- Focus indicators are visible
- Timer updates are announced via `aria-live`
